title: Under-specified: PCB standoff base
prompt: A base plate with standoffs to mount a small PCB like an Arduino Nano. Make the hole spacing adjustable.

hidden_tests.description: The model evaluates without feature or parameter errors
Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Plate and standoffs are one part
Sized for a small board: between 20 × 10 × 3 and 120 × 80 × 30 mm
Four holes for M2–M3 screws (tap or clearance, Ø1.5–3.6)
Adjustable hole spacing: at least two length parameters

questions: Which board exactly (hole pattern and hole size)?
How tall should the standoffs be?
Tapped holes for screws, heat-set inserts, or clearance holes?
clarify.assumptions: Arduino Nano-like 38 × 13.5 hole pattern, M2 tapped Ø6 × 5 standoffs on a 50 × 25.5 × 3 plate; the two spacings and the standoff height are parameters.
